rule: Open-source voices with permissive licences only. No voice cloning, no voice of a real named person imitated. A voice is used only when cleared is true AND .phaseB/MODEL_LICENSES.md has a 'Yes' row for it.

ja.licence: Apache-2.0 (model card: permissive / non-copyrighted training audio); pyopenjtalk MIT

ko.engine: MeloTTS KR, speed 0.92 + pitch -3 semitones (ffmpeg rubberband) — an audio effect on the same synthetic voice, not cloning

de.licence: dataset CC0; checkpoint lineage must be confirmed NOT fine-tuned from lessac (see MODEL_LICENSES.md Piper rows)

zh.engine: Kokoro-82M v1.0 + misaki[zh] (jieba MIT, pypinyin MIT, cn2an MIT)
zh.licence: Apache-2.0 weights (model card: trained only on permissive / non-copyrighted audio)

fr.engine: Kokoro-82M v1.0 + misaki (espeak-ng G2P for French)
fr.licence: Apache-2.0 weights; voice built from the SIWIS French speech corpus — credit 'SIWIS database' in the app's open-source credits (CC BY 4.0 attribution) before release

fr.engine: Kokoro ff_siwis, speed 0.95 + pitch -4 semitones (ffmpeg rubberband) — an audio effect on the same synthetic voice, not cloning

fr.licence: checkpoint lineage (fine-tuned from lessac?) not confirmed — same rule as the Piper rows in MODEL_LICENSES.md

ar.licence: training-data licence and checkpoint lineage NOT confirmed
Coqui Public Model Licence — non-commercial; also a cloning model

ar.engine: eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0 program; generated audio is ours)
ar.licence: usable, but robotic — not exam quality

notes: German audio stays blocked until the Piper checkpoint lineage is checked (owner/lead decision recorded in MODEL_LICENSES.md). The app then shows the script-free 'phone voice' practice only for German. Korean has one licence-clean voice: the second speaker is the same voice with a lower pitch, so dialogues stay clear. Stage 3 (lpstage3): Chinese uses four Kokoro Mandarin voices (2 F, 2 M). French has one licence-clean voice (Kokoro ff_siwis); the male speaker is the same voice pitch-lowered, never a cloned person. Arabic has NO licence-cleared natural voice yet (Piper kareem lineage unconfirmed; MMS and XTTS are non-commercial): every Arabic job is marked blocked and the app plays the phone's own system voice (Android TTS, nothing shipped) until a voice is cleared.
